protocol.scope: 491 map rows; public entry GET plus at most one same-host content candidate and one pagination candidate per unique URL; no production mutation
failure_contracts: All map rows retain IDs, duplicates and footer noise; no row omitted
HTTP 200, navigation text and links alone are not verified article extraction
Input fields on a portal do not imply news content requires input
Unknown robots from the same-day baseline permits a bounded diagnostic GET, not an unrestricted crawl; explicit denied paths stop
Login, CAPTCHA and WAF are reported, never bypassed; no identity or private subject query submitted
Each attempted request has a status or typed error; zero retries; failures are not permanent unavailability claims
Raw bodies are hashed; sensitive-pattern bodies are not retained; no cookie or credential headers retained
Classification is evidence-tiered and can be reproduced offline; content snippets are evidence, not full business acceptance

classification.B: 静态内容链接候选，详情未确认
classification.C: 查询输入或服务办理入口
classification.E: 限制访问或本轮失败，机制待确认
classification.F: 入口可读，但未确认正文渠道

scope: fresh GET per unique URL except baseline robots-denied paths and footer noise; optional one detail and next page; classifications require separate offline review
